-h.policyBasis: no effect is produced by a literal flag and stdin is never read (StdinNever), so no EffectPolicy has anything to judge

--help.policyBasis: same as -h: literal flag, no effect produced

positionals.policyBasis: uuidgen takes no operands (empty PositionalSpec): any operand is a stray positional that makes the node insufficient (fail-closed abstain); no EffectPolicy judges it
